description: First-mortgage sizing for a RAD property under FHA 223(f), FHA 221(d)(4), Freddie Mac (HUD Section 8), Fannie Mae Affordable Housing Preservation: the loan each execution supports by coverage and by loan ratio, which test binds, and annual debt service including FHA's 0.25% premium. Defaults come from HUD Mortgagee Letter 2025-03, the MAP Guide, 90 FR 45789 and the Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac term sheets, with HUD's median FHA note rates. Same math as rad.loans/tools/rad-debt-sizer/. A sketch, not a loan offer.

monthly_rent.description: Contract rent per unit per month, dollars

opex_per_unit.description: Operating costs per unit per year (default 7200)

other_income.description: Other income per unit per month (default 0)

reserves_per_unit.description: Replacement reserve per unit per year (default 350)

total_cost.description: Total development cost, for 221(d)(4) loan to cost

value.description: As-is or as-complete value, for the loan-to-value test

name: size_rad_debt
title: Size a RAD first mortgage
